subject.title: fix(security): exclude test files from plugin code-safety scans (#82469)

question: Should test-file exclusion apply only to plugin `plugins.code_safety` scans, or should installed-skill `skills.code_safety` scans also skip test-named files and directories?
rationale: The patch fixes a plugin-focused false positive by changing a helper shared with installed-skill scans, which decides a broader security-audit coverage boundary than the issue requested.

options.title: Narrow to plugin scans
options.body: Thread an option through `getCodeSafetySummary` and pass `excludeTestFiles: true` only from the plugin collector, preserving installed-skill coverage.

options.title: Accept broader skill exclusion
options.body: Keep the shared-helper behavior only if maintainers explicitly accept reduced installed-skill test-path coverage and require proof for that broader audit result.

options.title: Pause for audit policy
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want the canonical issue to settle string-literal masking or a broader audit-scope policy first.

recommendation.title: Narrow to plugin scans
recommendation.body: Thread an option through `getCodeSafetySummary` and pass `excludeTestFiles: true` only from the plugin collector, preserving installed-skill coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent security-audit hardening work makes this the strongest history signal for a scan-boundary decision.
